name: Morenatsu 2
source:
At the end of last summer, Juuichi gave his jacket to Hiroyuki, both as a way to remember him and as a contract that Hiroyuki will come back and return it to him.

Will things go smoothly between the two of them? Tora and Tatsuki might still feel something for Hiro! 

[From [url=https://sylos30.itch.io/morenatsu-2-fanbase-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
去年夏末，Juuichi把自己的外套交给了Hiroyuki，既是留作纪念，也相当于约定让Hiroyuki回来把外套还给他。

他们俩之间会顺利吗？Tora和Tatsuki或许仍对Hiro抱有情意！

[来源：[url=https://sylos30.itch.io/morenatsu-2-fanbase-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
